description.plain:
Classic charcoal — the quietly sharp winter neutral that works in a boardroom, on a flight, and at dinner afterwards.

This Merino Wool Turtle Neck Sweater in charcoal is the quietly premium winter piece every man should own one of. The soft rolled turtle neck sits cleanly against the skin, the fine-gauge knit falls beautifully through the body, and full-length long sleeves end in neat ribbed cuffs. A matching ribbed hem holds the silhouette clean. The small embroidered 98° North logo sits on the left chest in tonal charcoal grey — present but not loud, a quiet quality marker rather than a logo flex.

Merino wool is the quiet magic here. It's naturally temperature-regulating — breathable enough to wear in an AC conference room, warm enough to layer under a coat for a Delhi December. The fibre is naturally soft and smooth against the skin (nothing like coarse traditional wool), and the high turtle neck means it stays comfortable even without a shirt underneath. Merino is also naturally odour-resistant and wrinkle-resistant — it holds its shape through long travel days and stays fresh through longer wears between washes, which makes it genuinely one of the most practical winter pieces you can own.

The regular fit skims cleanly through the chest and shoulders without going bulky. Charcoal is the colour you reach for when you want to look pulled-together without thinking. Deeper than mid-grey, softer than black, endlessly easy to style with the rest of your wardrobe. Wear it with dark denim and chukka boots for the weekend, charcoal wool trousers and black loafers for the office, or layered under a camel overcoat for a sharp winter commute. From workdays in Bangalore to winter evenings in Delhi, this is the piece that quietly does everything.

Built for men who want one really well-made winter pullover that works harder than the five cheap ones it replaces — in office, in travel, in evening plans.
